name: Rahul Suntah
description: '''Rahul Suntah''' (born 6 June 1997) is a [[Mauritius|Mauritian]] [[composer]], [[music producer]] and [[pianist]]. Rahul attracted significant media attention from platforms such as [[BBC]] and [[ITV (TV network)|ITV]] for his viral piano covers of popular songs and original compositions reaching millions of views on Instagram as well as his innovative ways of playing the piano.
